name: Jersey Mike's Subs Inc.
px_note: DEBUT 2026-07-30: PRICED $23.00 (MID of $21-25, evening 07-29 per Reuters/CNBC; ~43.5M sh -> ~$1.0B gross; book reportedly ~15x covered) then BROKE ISSUE: opened $21.00 (-8.7%), high ~$22.01, last $22.01 (-4.3% vs pricing; IBKR conid 905562813). NOTE: dispatch premise 'priced at the bottom ~$21' was WRONG - $21 was the OPEN, not the pricing (tape-verify doctrine validated again). 424B4 NOT yet on EDGAR as of 07-30 (FTS zero hits); 8-A12B acc 0001193125-26-324302 + NYSE CERT acc 0000876661-26-000648 filed 07-30; greenshoe exercise unknown (presumed UNEXERCISED - broken deals get covered via stabilization buying).
verdict: DECLINE at range / WAIT band $15-18 (court 2026-07-29; two-mode DD, modes corroborate; Mode A = S-1/A forensics acc 0001193125-26-308260, Mode B = independent outside view). GOOD COMPANY, WRONG PRICE, ADVERSE STRUCTURE: ~26.5x FY25 adj-EBITDA (EV ~$9.0B at $23 mid, FD equity $7.31B incl Up-C units) for comps decelerating 8.4->2.0->3.2->2.5/2.0% (FY23->H1-26, price/mix-driven) into a -3.0% QSR-traffic category (Placer Q2-26). Deserved 18-22x = $16-19/sh generous, $14-16 strict; the ask is 25-40% above it. RE-COURT 2026-07-30 (see recourt_20260730): VERDICT UNCHANGED - priced $23 mid, broke issue to $21-22; ask at tape = 24.7-25.6x vs deserved 18-22x; band $15-18 unchanged; path to band ACCELERATED (broken-IPO drift, stabilization ends ~Aug-29, lockup ~Jan-25/26-2027).

structure_findings.leverage: SEV 7: $2,099M WBS notes at 3/29/26; Master Issuer leverage >5.0x at 12/28/25 (triggered mandatory $5M paydown); pro-forma ~$1.80B vs ~$339M adj EBITDA = ~5.3x gross; nearest anticipated repayment Feb-2029.
structure_findings.control: SEV 5: Blackstone 76.5% voting post-IPO, controlled-company exemption; Blackstone Securities = declared FINRA conflicts underwriter. One-vote-per-share both classes (clean); Deloitte; top-tier syndicate (MS/Jef/JPM) - zero underwriter-archetype risk.
structure_findings.nongaap: SEV 5: adj EBITDA $339M vs GAAP NI $55M (Q1-26 GAAP LOSS $24M); adds back Area Director buyouts ($44M FY25, $28M Q1-26) while keeping the $8M/qtr savings; founder discretionary + ad-fund timing addbacks.
structure_findings.grooming: SEV 3-4: AUV/SSS exclude stores <425 days (~14mo, longer than the usual ~12-13mo comp entry); cover's '50% cumulative 2020-25 SSS' = a SUM of six annual prints; 42% cash-on-cash uses franchisee-self-reported build costs ex pre-opening.

business_quality: CLEAN and verified (the Mode B refutation of the full bear): AUV $1.37M (~3x Subway), store-level EBITDA ~16% (~$224k on ~$515k build = ~40% cash-on-cash), 3,300 stores/50 states, $4.3B systemwide, 20 consecutive positive-SSS years, 1,600-store pipeline 90% from EXISTING franchisees (informed insiders re-upping), Subway structural retreat (-8,345 units since 2016, 18.7k remaining at ~$500k AUV) = a large share-donor pool. The disconfirmation lands on the SECURITY, not the sandwich.
honesty_grade: REVIEW-not-flag: numbers disclosed plainly but marketed takeaway diverges at the margin - 'accelerating transaction growth' headlines while the YoY comp series halves (H1-26 2.0% vs 4.2%); definitional grooming (425-day comp entry, summed 'cumulative SSS') flatters without concealing.

recourt_20260730.type: LIGHT RE-COURT (the court's own re-court-before-entry condition; pipeline v1.6) - rule on what changed, no re-derivation
recourt_20260730.ruling: VERDICT UNCHANGED: DECLINE at tape (~$22) / WAIT band $15-18 unchanged / edge NONE unchanged. CSP pipeline stays ARMED with conditions RESTATED (v2 below): the raw IV>=50 gate is replaced by a premium-economics gate.
recourt_20260730.premise_correction: Dispatch premise 'PRICED AT THE BOTTOM ~$21' is FALSE. Verified: priced $23.00 = the MIDPOINT (Reuters exclusive 07-29, CNBC 07-30), ~43.5M sh, ~$1.0B gross, book reportedly ~15x oversubscribed - then BROKE ISSUE at the open: $21.00 (-8.7%), last $22.01 (-4.3%). The $21 was the OPEN. This is a WORSE fact pattern than bottom-pricing: the book cleared at mid and the aftermarket refused it anyway (headline oversubscription was price-insensitive/padded). Tape-verify-price-action-premises doctrine validated again.
recourt_20260730.what_it_means: A broken IPO validates the DECLINE mechanically AND kills the CAVA-pop branch the court had hedged (pop probability -> ~0; there is no pop to unwind). Path to the $15-18 band: ACCELERATED - months not quarters. Sequence: stabilization bid + presumed-unexercised-shoe short-covering support ends ~Aug-29; first print ~Oct-Nov into decelerating comps; Jan-25/26-2027 lockup releases ~4.9x-float of Blackstone paper (212M Class A-equiv) after a below-issue tape - the DNUT/PTLO drift template, now starting from below issue on day one. BAND ITSELF UNCHANGED: $15-18 was derived from 18-22x EBITDA fundamentals, not from the deal price; nothing in the debut changes FY25 EBITDA or the comp trajectory.
recourt_20260730.multiple_at_tape: FD 317.8M sh, net debt ~$1.69B, adj-EBITDA $339M: at $23 pricing 26.5x (the court's number, unchanged); at $21.00 open 24.7x; at $22.01 last 25.6x. Honest read: the gap to the deserved 18-22x band ($14-19/sh) narrowed from 25-40% rich to ~16-25% rich - direction right, still a clear NO. Reuters' $6.7B debut valuation corroborates the court's share count (317.8M x ~$21 = $6.7B).

csp_conditions_v2.supersedes: csp_plan_20260730 gate set (IV>=50 raw gate RETIRED: a broken no-pop debut likely lists IV 40-60 not 60-90; IV was always a proxy - the real gate is the basis the premium buys)

csp_conditions_v2.tenor: REQUIRED: expiry ACROSS the lockup -> Feb-19-2027 monthly or later (Jan-15-2027 monthly expires BEFORE the ~Jan-25/26 lockup and harvests vol only). If the fresh chain's longest expiry < lockup date: NO-GO on the core structure; a short-tenor tranche only if premium exceptional (17.5/18p >= 1.75 for <=3mo).
csp_conditions_v2.strike_premium: 18p (17.5p acceptable) at >= 1.25 -> basis <= 16.75 = mid-band. FLOOR: if the 18p Feb-2027+ bids < 1.00, NO-GO - the IV didn't deliver; revert to GTC limit ladder in the band (17.5/16.5/15.5), which the no-premium-selling-in-taxable doctrine prefers anyway (this CSP = user-proposed exception accepted 07-29; ST-ordinary-income tax note stands).
csp_conditions_v2.thinness: two-sided live quotes required; spread <= 0.20 or <= 15% of mid; rest at mid, never cross; OI may be ~0 in week one - acceptable only with live two-sided markets; size 1-3 contracts (<= $5.4k assignment notional).
csp_conditions_v2.spot_gate: only while spot >= 19.5. Below 19.5 the band is near - cancel the put, buy via GTC ladder instead (the short put would cap the entry we actually want). Assignment at <= 16.75 is IN-BAND and acceptable; entry re-court fires on band-touch regardless.
csp_conditions_v2.parametric: restaurant name - clear by mandate (verify at execution, per plan)

THE SEQUENCE: (1) debut - band watch already armed at 18, disclosure_watch fires on the 424B4; (2) LIGHT RE-COURT once final terms + a few days of tape exist (the court's own re-court-before-entry condition - it should specifically rule on the CSP structure); (3) when options LIST, check IV: fresh-IPO chains often print 60-90 IV - if rich, price the Sep/Oct 17.5-18 put. Gate check at entry: OI/spread (fresh chains are thin week one), granularity (1 contract = $1.8k = FINE), Parametric (restaurant name - clear by mandate, verify).
